text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before practice at summer training camp, 
Vivlos was enjoying the ocean with her 
family. With Cheval Grand, the atmosphere 
felt just like the good old days when they 
were younger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos was full of spirit, but she 
couldn't afford to let her guard down. 
Formidable rivals stood in her way at the 
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand, Satono Crown, and of course, 
Kitasan Black—who wouldn't be an 
exaggeration to call the strongest 
Umamusume of this era.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Undeterred, Vivlos actually looks forward 
to the showdown. Determined to become the 
best and strong enough to win in Dubai, 
she gears up enthusiastically for the 
summer training camp.
